# Provenance: entry_history_active

**Source**: live `GET /api/entry/1234567/history/` from the real FPL API on
2026-10-19 (curl, no auth), for #102.

**Edits**: a randomly chosen id with picks this season; `current`, `past` and `chips` trimmed to their first 2 / 1 / 1 entries. Values are otherwise as received. The history response
carries no manager or team names, so none were removed.
